records.context: The cell level follows brieflow. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.aggregate_genes#9
records.source: THE CELL LEVEL FOLLOWS BRIEFLOW. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.translation: 세포 수준은 BRIEFLOW를 따릅니다. Brieflow(Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT 라이선스)는 유전자를 그 모든 세포의 중앙값으로 요약합니다(``lib.aggregate.aggregate``, 기준은 ``gene_symbol_0``). 그러면 세포가 많은 가이드가 세포가 적은 가이드보다 더 큰 비중을 갖는 반면, 가이드 수준은 모든 가이드에 한 표씩 줍니다. Funk et al. 2022의 플레이트 A에서 세포 수준은 TVN 공간의 평균 retrieval mAP를 0.0602에서 0.0639로 높였습니다.

records.translation: 유전자마다 한 행이며 ``gene``, ``n_cells``, ``features``가 있습니다. 비표적 행(이름이 ``control_prefix`` 또는 ``NTpseudo``로 시작)은 행으로 유지되지만 적합하지 않습니다.

records.context: when fewer than two directions have lambda above 1.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.contrastive_weighting#10
records.source: when fewer than two directions have lambda above 1.
records.translation: lambda가 1보다 큰 방향이 두 개 미만인 경우입니다.

records.context: The gene rows are embedded (standardised, PCA 99 %) and the guide rows put in the same space. The noise covariance is the Ledoit-Wolf covariance (Ledoit & Wolf 2004) of the centred non-targeting guide rows, divided by ``kbar``, the mean number of guides per targeting gene, since a gene profile pools that many guides. The generalised eigenproblem ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v`` gives directions ordered by signal over noise; each is weighted by ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``, a Wiener weight. This is a contrastive eigenproblem in the spirit of contrastive PCA (Abid et al. 2018).
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.contrastive_weighting#11
records.source: The gene rows are embedded (standardised, PCA 99 %) and the guide rows put in the same space. The noise covariance is the Ledoit-Wolf covariance (Ledoit & Wolf 2004) of the centred non-targeting guide rows, divided by ``kbar``, the mean number of guides per targeting gene, since a gene profile pools that many guides. The generalised eigenproblem ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v`` gives directions ordered by signal over noise; each is weighted by ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``, a Wiener weight. This is a contrastive eigenproblem in the spirit of contrastive PCA (Abid et al. 2018).
records.translation: 유전자 행을 임베딩하고(표준화, PCA 99 %), 가이드 행을 같은 공간에 놓습니다. 잡음 공분산은 중심화한 비표적 가이드 행의 Ledoit-Wolf 공분산(Ledoit & Wolf 2004)을 표적 유전자당 평균 가이드 수인 ``kbar``로 나눈 것입니다. 유전자 프로파일이 그만큼의 가이드를 합치기 때문입니다. 일반화 고유값 문제 ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v``는 신호 대 잡음 순으로 정렬된 방향을 주며, 각 방향은 Wiener 가중치인 ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``로 가중됩니다. 이는 contrastive PCA(Abid et al. 2018)의 취지를 따른 대비 고유값 문제입니다.

records.context: It refuses a degenerate space. On profiles already shrunk toward the controls (:func:`shrink_gene_profiles`) no direction rises above the noise, every weight is 0 and every row the zero vector; a retrieval score then ranks ties first and reports AP = 1. Do not stack the two.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.contrastive_weighting#12
records.source: IT REFUSES A DEGENERATE SPACE. On profiles already shrunk toward the controls (:func:`shrink_gene_profiles`) no direction rises above the noise, every weight is 0 and every row the zero vector; a retrieval score then ranks ties first and reports AP = 1. Do not stack the two.
records.translation: 퇴화된 공간은 거부합니다. 이미 대조군 쪽으로 수축된 프로파일(:func:`shrink_gene_profiles`)에서는 어떤 방향도 잡음보다 올라오지 않아 모든 가중치가 0이고 모든 행이 영벡터가 됩니다. 그러면 retrieval 점수는 동률을 먼저 순위 매기고 AP = 1을 보고합니다. 둘을 겹쳐 쓰지 마십시오.

records.context: The guide model is jacks' rank-1 model (Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118), with the profile features in the role of JACKS' screening experiments: each guide row is ``x_g = e_g m + noise``, the noise variance proportional to ``1 / n_cells(g)``. Starting from ``e = 1``, ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2`` (``w`` the cell counts) and ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)`` alternate, ``e`` rescaled so its maximum is 1, for at most ``iters`` rounds or until ``e`` changes by less than 1e-6. The efficacy-weighted profile ``M`` is then blended with the all-cell gene profile ``Z`` as unit vectors. A gene row without guide rows keeps ``Z``. The method uses no reference labels.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.guide_efficacy_profiles#8
records.source: THE GUIDE MODEL IS JACKS' RANK-1 MODEL (Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118), with the profile features in the role of JACKS' screens: each guide row is ``x_g = e_g m + noise``, the noise variance proportional to ``1 / n_cells(g)``. Starting from ``e = 1``, ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2`` (``w`` the cell counts) and ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)`` alternate, ``e`` rescaled so its maximum is 1, for at most ``iters`` rounds or until ``e`` changes by less than 1e-6. The efficacy-weighted profile ``M`` is then blended with the all-cell gene profile ``Z`` as unit vectors. A gene row without guide rows keeps ``Z``. The method uses no reference labels.
records.translation: 가이드 모델은 JACKS의 랭크 1 모델입니다(Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118). 프로파일 특징이 JACKS의 스크리닝 실험 역할을 합니다. 각 가이드 행은 ``x_g = e_g m + noise``이고, 잡음 분산은 ``1 / n_cells(g)``에 비례합니다. ``e = 1``에서 시작하여 ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2``(``w``는 세포 수)와 ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)``를 번갈아 계산하며, ``e``는 최댓값이 1이 되도록 다시 스케일링하고, 최대 ``iters`` 라운드 동안 또는 ``e``의 변화가 1e-6보다 작아질 때까지 반복합니다. 그런 다음 효능 가중 프로파일 ``M``을 전체 세포 유전자 프로파일 ``Z``와 단위 벡터로 혼합합니다. 가이드 행이 없는 유전자 행은 ``Z``를 유지합니다. 이 방법은 기준 레이블을 사용하지 않습니다.

records.context: The guides are embedded as the benchmark embeds them (standardised, PCA 99 %, fitted on the guides) and scaled to unit length; ``s(A, B)`` is the mean of the ``k_A x k_B`` guide-guide cosines. The null of a pair is ``null_size`` similarities between two random guide sets of the same sizes, each guide from a distinct random targeting gene, so a P value asks whether two genes agree more than random guides do. Benjamini- Hochberg gives ``q`` across all pairs. The pseudo-genes, paired with every tested gene, should give uniform P values; the share under 0.05 is the calibration control. Non-targeting guide sets give a second null, reported for comparison. Without reference sets this does not annotate pairs with CORUM or STRING; :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters` scores those.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.guide_level_similarity#10
records.source: The guides are embedded as the benchmark embeds them (standardised, PCA 99 %, fitted on the guides) and scaled to unit length; ``s(A, B)`` is the mean of the ``k_A x k_B`` guide-guide cosines. The null of a pair is ``null_size`` similarities between two random guide sets of the same sizes, each guide from a distinct random targeting gene, so a P value asks whether two genes agree more than random guides do. Benjamini- Hochberg gives ``q`` across all pairs. The pseudo-genes, paired with every tested gene, should give uniform P values; the share under 0.05 is the calibration control. Non-targeting guide sets give a second null, reported for comparison. Without reference sets this does not annotate pairs with CORUM or STRING; :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters` scores those.
records.translation: 가이드는 벤치마크가 임베딩하는 방식대로 임베딩되고(표준화, PCA 99 %, 가이드로 적합) 단위 길이로 스케일링됩니다. ``s(A, B)``는 ``k_A x k_B``개 가이드 간 cosine의 평균입니다. 한 쌍의 귀무분포는 같은 크기의 두 무작위 가이드 집합 사이의 ``null_size``개 유사도이며, 각 가이드는 서로 다른 무작위 표적 유전자에서 나오므로, P 값은 두 유전자가 무작위 가이드보다 더 일치하는지를 묻습니다. Benjamini- Hochberg가 모든 쌍에 걸쳐 ``q``를 줍니다. 검정한 모든 유전자와 짝지은 유사 유전자는 균일한 P 값을 내야 하며, 0.05 미만의 비율이 보정 대조입니다. 비표적 가이드 집합은 두 번째 귀무분포를 주며, 비교를 위해 보고됩니다. 기준 집합이 없으면 쌍에 CORUM이나 STRING 주석을 달지 않으며, :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters`가 그것을 채점합니다.

records.context: A receiver is exposed to gene X when a genotyped neighbour carries X; a neighbour with the receiver's own guide never counts, so clone sisters are not exposures, and the reference is exposure to a control neighbour. Receiver features are its TVN components minus its own gene's mean in the microplate sample position, residualised within microscope field of view on local density and radial position (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). The statistic is ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``, ``d`` the exposed-minus-reference mean and ``v`` its microscope field of view-clustered variance. Nulls: genotypes shuffled within each microscope field of view, and a clone-preserving shuffle that moves whole same-guide clusters; the control pseudo-genes are exposures too. ``p`` is empirical against the pooled null genes of the same exposure-count quintile, ``q`` Benjamini-Hochberg across genes.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.neighbour_effects#10
records.source: A receiver is exposed to gene X when a genotyped neighbour carries X; a neighbour with the receiver's own guide never counts, so clone sisters are not exposures, and the reference is exposure to a control neighbour. Receiver features are its TVN components minus its own gene's mean in the well, residualised within field on local density and radial position (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). The statistic is ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``, ``d`` the exposed-minus-reference mean and ``v`` its field-clustered variance. Nulls: genotypes shuffled within each field, and a clone-preserving shuffle that moves whole same-guide clusters; the control pseudo-genes are exposures too. ``p`` is empirical against the pooled null genes of the same exposure-count quintile, ``q`` Benjamini-Hochberg across genes.
records.translation: 유전자형이 정해진 이웃이 X를 지니면 수신자는 유전자 X에 노출됩니다. 수신자 자신의 가이드를 가진 이웃은 세지 않으므로 클론 자매는 노출이 아니며, 기준은 대조군 이웃에 대한 노출입니다. 수신자 특징은 그 TVN 성분에서 웰 안 자기 유전자의 평균을 뺀 값이며, 시야 안에서 국소 밀도와 방사 위치에 대해 잔차화합니다(Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). 통계량은 ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``이며, ``d``는 노출 평균에서 기준 평균을 뺀 값, ``v``는 그 시야 군집 분산입니다. 귀무분포는 각 시야 안에서 섞은 유전자형과, 같은 가이드 군집 전체를 옮기는 클론 보존 셔플입니다. 대조군 유사 유전자도 노출입니다. ``p``는 같은 노출 수 오분위의 합친 귀무 유전자에 대한 경험적 값이며, ``q``는 유전자 전체에 걸친 Benjamini-Hochberg입니다.

A pseudo-gene is processed exactly as a gene, so it is the null a gene's statistic is compared against. One row per barcode is Brieflow's layout (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026).
records.translation: 유사 유전자는 개선된 Funk 플레이트 A 분석에서처럼 추출합니다. 정렬된 고유 비표적 가이드를 ``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``로 순열하고, 가이드 ``i``를 유사 유전자 ``rank_i // group_size``에 넣습니다. 여기서 ``rank_i``는 순열에서의 위치입니다. 유사 유전자는 유전자와 똑같이 처리되므로, 유전자 통계량과 비교되는 귀무 역할을 합니다. 바코드마다 한 행은 Brieflow의 배치 방식입니다(Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026).

records.context: Every cell is scored by a model that never saw its field. Fields go to folds by name (:func:`field_folds`). For each fold an L2 logistic regression (balanced classes) is trained on the gene's and the controls' cells of the other folds, and the held-out gene cells are placed on the held-out control cells: ``u`` is their control percentile, uniform without an effect, and ``z`` their control z score. The penetrance is Storey's estimator on ``u`` (:func:`storey_penetrance`) with a 95 % interval from resampling whole fields; escapers are tested on ``z`` (:func:`escaper_statistics`), and a call stands only if none of ``simulations`` unimodal simulations of the fitted shift makes it. Guides are compared by the share of their cells above half the responder mode (chi-square). CONTROLS: the non-targeting pseudo-genes (:func:`nt_row_names`) scored against the pool without their own cells, which should show no penetrance; and ``shuffled`` genes whose gene and control labels are permuted, whose penetrance should fall to the real cells' share times the gene's penetrance.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.penetrance_tests#20
records.source: EVERY CELL IS SCORED BY A MODEL THAT NEVER SAW ITS FIELD. Fields go to folds by name (:func:`field_folds`). For each fold an L2 logistic regression (balanced classes) is trained on the gene's and the controls' cells of the other folds, and the held-out gene cells are placed on the held-out control cells: ``u`` is their control percentile, uniform without an effect, and ``z`` their control z score. The penetrance is Storey's estimator on ``u`` (:func:`storey_penetrance`) with a 95 % interval from resampling whole fields; escapers are tested on ``z`` (:func:`escaper_statistics`), and a call stands only if none of ``simulations`` unimodal simulations of the fitted shift makes it. Guides are compared by the share of their cells above half the responder mode (chi-square). CONTROLS: the non-targeting pseudo-genes (:func:`nt_row_names`) scored against the pool without their own cells, which should show no penetrance; and ``shuffled`` genes whose gene and control labels are permuted, whose penetrance should fall to the real cells' share times the gene's penetrance.
records.translation: 모든 세포는 그 시야를 본 적 없는 모델로 채점합니다. 시야는 이름에 따라 폴드에 배정됩니다(:func:`field_folds`). 각 폴드에서 L2 로지스틱 회귀(균형 클래스)를 다른 폴드의 유전자 세포와 대조군 세포로 학습하고, 홀드아웃 유전자 세포를 홀드아웃 대조군 세포 위에 놓습니다. ``u``는 그 대조군 백분위수로 효과가 없으면 균일하고, ``z``는 대조군 z 점수입니다. 침투도는 ``u``에 대한 Storey 추정량(:func:`storey_penetrance`)이며, 시야 전체를 재표본 추출한 95 % 구간을 함께 줍니다. 이탈 세포는 ``z``로 검정하며(:func:`escaper_statistics`), 적합한 이동의 ``simulations``개 단봉 시뮬레이션 중 어느 것도 같은 호출을 하지 않을 때만 호출이 유지됩니다. 가이드는 반응자 모드의 절반보다 높은 세포 비율로 비교합니다(chi-square). 대조군: 자체 세포를 뺀 풀과 비교해 채점하는 비표적 유사 유전자(:func:`nt_row_names`)로, 침투도가 없어야 합니다. 그리고 유전자와 대조군 레이블을 순열한 ``shuffled`` 유전자로, 그 침투도는 실제 세포의 비율에 유전자의 침투도를 곱한 값까지 떨어져야 합니다.

records.context: Profiles are ``pooled`` (every cell, centred on its well's controls) and each phase (that phase's cells, centred on the well's controls of the same phase); a guide is the median of its cells, with at least three. A gene's statistic is ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d`` over the dimensions, ``M`` the mean of its guides and ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)``, the noise fitted on the control guides of the first half of the pseudo-genes; the second half is held out. ``T`` is referred to a scaled chi-square matched to the null sets' mean and variance. The targeting null is the main one: every targeting guide cuts DNA, control guides do not, so against controls almost every gene differs pooled. The interaction profiles test a phase against the gene's other cells. A gene is phase-specific when its phase ``q < 0.1`` (Benjamini-Hochberg) and its pooled ``q >= 0.1``.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.phase_tests#13
records.source: Profiles are ``pooled`` (every cell, centred on its well's controls) and each phase (that phase's cells, centred on the well's controls of the same phase); a guide is the median of its cells, with at least three. A gene's statistic is ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d`` over the dimensions, ``M`` the mean of its guides and ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)``, the noise fitted on the control guides of the first half of the pseudo-genes; the second half is held out. ``T`` is referred to a scaled chi-square matched to the null sets' mean and variance. The targeting null is the main one: every targeting guide cuts DNA, control guides do not, so against controls almost every gene differs pooled. The interaction profiles test a phase against the gene's other cells. A gene is phase-specific when its phase ``q < 0.1`` (Benjamini-Hochberg) and its pooled ``q >= 0.1``.
records.translation: 프로파일은 ``pooled``(모든 세포, 웰의 대조군을 중심으로 맞춤)와 각 단계(그 단계의 세포, 같은 단계의 웰 대조군을 중심으로 맞춤)입니다. 가이드는 세포가 적어도 세 개일 때 그 세포들의 중앙값입니다. 유전자의 통계량은 차원에 걸친 ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d``이며, ``M``은 가이드들의 평균이고 ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)``는 유사 유전자 첫 절반의 대조군 가이드로 적합한 잡음입니다. 나머지 절반은 홀드아웃합니다. ``T``는 귀무 집합의 평균과 분산에 맞춘 스케일 chi-square와 비교합니다. 주된 것은 표적 귀무분포입니다. 모든 표적 가이드는 DNA를 자르지만 대조군 가이드는 그렇지 않으므로, 대조군과 비교하면 합쳤을 때 거의 모든 유전자가 다릅니다. 상호작용 프로파일은 한 단계를 유전자의 다른 세포와 비교해 검정합니다. 유전자의 단계 ``q < 0.1``(Benjamini-Hochberg)이고 합친 ``q >= 0.1``이면 그 유전자는 단계 특이적입니다.

records.context: Per feature ``d``, a guide's noise is the between-guide variance ``a_d`` of the non-targeting guides plus the sampling variance of a median of ``n`` cells, ``(pi / 2) v_d / n`` with ``v_d = 1``. For each gene that noise, averaged over its guides, is pooled with the gene's own between-guide variance (``K - 1`` degrees of freedom against ``prior_df``), so a gene whose guides disagree is shrunk more. The prior signal variance ``tau2_d`` comes from the moments of the targeting genes, and the gene's mean guide profile, centred on the non-targeting guides, is multiplied by ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``. This is empirical-Bayes variance moderation (Smyth 2004) followed by a James-Stein-type shrinkage. Do not stack it with :func:`contrastive_weighting`, which then has no direction left.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.shrink_gene_profiles#7
records.source: Per feature ``d``, a guide's noise is the between-guide variance ``a_d`` of the non-targeting guides plus the sampling variance of a median of ``n`` cells, ``(pi / 2) v_d / n`` with ``v_d = 1``. For each gene that noise, averaged over its guides, is pooled with the gene's own between-guide variance (``K - 1`` degrees of freedom against ``prior_df``), so a gene whose guides disagree is shrunk more. The prior signal variance ``tau2_d`` comes from the moments of the targeting genes, and the gene's mean guide profile, centred on the non-targeting guides, is multiplied by ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``. This is empirical-Bayes variance moderation (Smyth 2004) followed by a James-Stein-type shrinkage. Do not stack it with :func:`contrastive_weighting`, which then has no direction left.
records.translation: 특징 ``d``마다 가이드의 잡음은 비표적 가이드의 가이드 간 분산 ``a_d``에 ``n``개 세포 중앙값의 표본 분산 ``(pi / 2) v_d / n``(``v_d = 1``)을 더한 것입니다. 각 유전자에서 가이드에 걸쳐 평균한 이 잡음을 유전자 자신의 가이드 간 분산과 합치므로(``K - 1`` 자유도 대 ``prior_df``), 가이드끼리 어긋나는 유전자가 더 많이 수축됩니다. 사전 신호 분산 ``tau2_d``는 표적 유전자의 적률에서 구하며, 비표적 가이드를 중심으로 맞춘 유전자의 평균 가이드 프로파일에 ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``를 곱합니다. 이는 경험적 베이즈 분산 조정(Smyth 2004)에 이어 James-Stein형 수축을 적용한 것입니다. :func:`contrastive_weighting`과 겹쳐 쓰지 마십시오. 그러면 남는 방향이 없습니다.

records.context: Vacuoles and cells come from :func:`vacuole_objects` (or saved tables). Every microplate sample position gets its strain, status and dose from ``titration_plate_map``. Vacuoles under the parasite-signal floor (:func:`infection_floor`) are dropped and cells are called infected from the kept vacuoles. With ``replication_classifier='hist_gbm'`` the machine-learning classification model is cross-validated on ``replication_training_table`` (:func:`replication_classifier_cv`) and predicts parasites per vacuole after the size calibration (:func:`size_calibration`, on the kept vacuoles of infected microplate sample positions). Writes titration_vacuoles.csv, titration_per_well.csv, titration_per_condition.csv, titration_calibration.txt and replication_classifier_cv.txt to ``<src>/results/titration/``.

records.context: Every cell gets its group from ``translocation_groups`` (by microplate sample position row, or by microplate sample position from a laboratory microplate map) and two readouts: raw (``ha_total_nucleus``) and corrected (``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``). Cells with nuclei under ``translocation_min_nucleus_size`` are left out. Curves bin cells by k = vacuoles per cell up to ``translocation_kmax`` and divide by the k = 0 cells of the same group; per-microplate sample position ratios use microplate sample positions with ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin`` cells in the bin. The controls are the k = 0 reference, the ``translocation_null_percentile`` threshold of the corrected mean in k = 0 cells (% positive nuclei per k and per microplate sample position), the within-field shuffle of k (``translocation_shuffle_n`` times, seed ``translocation_seed``, group by group, raw then corrected), the DNA control, nucleus area and the excluded fraction.
records.label: spacr.host_pathogen.translocation_summary#1
records.source: Every cell gets its group from ``translocation_groups`` (by well row, or by well from a plate map) and two readouts: raw (``ha_total_nucleus``) and corrected (``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``). Cells with nuclei under ``translocation_min_nucleus_size`` are left out. Curves bin cells by k = vacuoles per cell up to ``translocation_kmax`` and divide by the k = 0 cells of the same group; per-well ratios use wells with ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin`` cells in the bin. The controls are the k = 0 reference, the ``translocation_null_percentile`` threshold of the corrected mean in k = 0 cells (% positive nuclei per k and per well), the within-field shuffle of k (``translocation_shuffle_n`` times, seed ``translocation_seed``, group by group, raw then corrected), the DNA control, nucleus area and the excluded fraction.
records.translation: 모든 세포는 ``translocation_groups``에서 그룹을 받고(웰 행 기준 또는 플레이트 맵의 웰 기준), 두 가지 판독을 가집니다. 원시(``ha_total_nucleus``)와 보정(``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``)입니다. 핵이 ``translocation_min_nucleus_size``보다 작은 세포는 제외합니다. 곡선은 세포를 k = 세포당 액포 수로 ``translocation_kmax``까지 구간화하고 같은 그룹의 k = 0 세포로 나눕니다. 웰별 비율은 구간에 ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin``개 세포가 있는 웰을 사용합니다. 대조는 k = 0 기준, k = 0 세포에서 보정 평균의 ``translocation_null_percentile`` 임계값(k별 및 웰별 % 양성 핵), k의 시야 내 셔플(``translocation_shuffle_n``회, 시드 ``translocation_seed``, 그룹별로, 원시 다음 보정), DNA 대조, 핵 면적, 제외 비율입니다.

records.context: Every stratum (each combination of the ``strata`` structured-data names) contributes up to ``ceil(n / number of strata)`` objects drawn with ``seed``; when that falls short of ``n`` the rest is drawn from what is left, spread over the first structured-data name with ``seed + 1``. records.source: Every stratum (each combination of the ``strata`` keys) contributes up to ``ceil(n / number of strata)`` objects drawn with ``seed``; when that falls short of ``n`` the rest is drawn from what is left, spread over the first key with ``seed + 1``. The result is shuffled with ``seed + 2`` and cut to ``n``. A stratum key ``column:q`` bins the column into q quantiles by rank within each value of the first key.
records.translation: 모든 층(``strata`` 키의 각 조합)은 최대 ``ceil(n / number of strata)``개 객체를 제공하며, ``seed``로 추출합니다. 그것이 ``n``에 못 미치면 나머지는 남은 것에서 첫 번째 키에 걸쳐 고르게 ``seed + 1``로 추출합니다. 결과는 ``seed + 2``로 섞은 뒤 ``n``개로 자릅니다. 층 키 ``column:q``는 첫 번째 키의 각 값 안에서 순위에 따라 열을 q개 분위수로 나눕니다.

records.context: The model of ``ml_model_type`` is trained on every fold of ``ml_eval_split`` (:func:`evaluation_folds`) and predicts the held-out rows. records.source: The model of ``ml_model_type`` is trained on every fold of ``ml_eval_split`` (:func:`evaluation_folds`) and predicts the held-out rows. One row per fold and one pooled row (every held-out prediction together) are reported. The controls of ``ml_eval_controls`` are reported the same way: ``majority`` always predicts the commonest label of the whole set; ``shuffled`` trains on labels permuted within each training fold, repeated ``ml_eval_shuffle_repeats`` times with seeds ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed``, ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed + 1``, ... and averaged.
records.translation: ``ml_model_type``의 모델을 ``ml_eval_split``의 각 폴드에서 학습하고(:func:`evaluation_folds`) 홀드아웃 행을 예측합니다. 폴드마다 한 행과 합친 행 하나(모든 홀드아웃 예측을 합한 것)를 보고합니다. ``ml_eval_controls``의 대조군도 같은 방식으로 보고합니다. ``majority``는 항상 전체 집합에서 가장 흔한 레이블을 예측하고, ``shuffled``는 각 학습 폴드 안에서 순열한 레이블로 학습하며 ``ml_eval_shuffle_repeats``번 시드 ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed``, ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed + 1``, ...로 반복하여 평균을 냅니다.

A sequence-only model (:data:`SEQUENCE_FEATURES`) measures how much of the separation comes from how the decoys were built; chance is an AUROC of 0.5. records.translation: 학습 시야의 라이브러리 호출과 학습용 절반의 디코이로 학습하고, 홀드아웃 시야의 라이브러리 호출과 평가용 절반의 디코이로 채점하므로, 어떤 시야나 디코이 서열도 학습과 검정에 함께 쓰이지 않습니다. 서열 전용 모델(:data:`SEQUENCE_FEATURES`)은 분리 중 얼마만큼이 디코이 생성 방식에서 오는지를 측정합니다. 우연 수준은 AUROC 0.5입니다. 평균 절대 SHAP(Lundberg and Lee 2017)과 순열 중요도(average-precision 감소)로 특징의 순위를 매깁니다.

records.context: Each microscope field of view is decoded permissively (:data:`QC_PERMISSIVE`) against the library and the decoys. Every read owned by a microscope field of view's nucleus becomes a row with its match, per-cycle margins and mismatches, spot features and position; every owned nucleus becomes a row labelled ``FP`` (its reads vote for a decoy), ``TP`` (a guide) or ``TN`` (no call), with the mean evidence of its supporting reads and the sequence features of its guide. Half the microscope fields of view of each laboratory microplate are held out (``test``), and the decoys are split by the md5 of their sequence into a training half and an evaluation half (``decoy_half``).
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.false_call_tables#1
records.source: Each field is decoded permissively (:data:`QC_PERMISSIVE`) against the library and the decoys. Every read owned by a field's nucleus becomes a row with its match, per-cycle margins and mismatches, spot features and position; every owned nucleus becomes a row labelled ``FP`` (its reads vote for a decoy), ``TP`` (a guide) or ``TN`` (no call), with the mean evidence of its supporting reads and the sequence features of its guide. Half the fields of each plate are held out (``test``), and the decoys are split by the md5 of their sequence into a training half and an evaluation half (``decoy_half``).

records.context: A call to a decoy is a known false call. Out of fold, by sequencing field (five folds keyed on the field's name, so a field is never scored by a model that saw it), four models estimate P(decoy | evidence) from each call's read and pixel support (:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`): logistic regression on the features and their squares, an isotonic recalibration of that score, histogram gradient boosting, and the decoy rate of matched strata. A real call's error is then ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``, and ``genotype_confidence`` is one minus it. A control fits the logistic model on decoy labels shuffled within fields; its AUC should be 0.5.
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.genotype_confidence#1
records.source: A call to a decoy is a known false call. Out of fold, by sequencing field (five folds keyed on the field's name, so a field is never scored by a model that saw it), four models estimate P(decoy | evidence) from each call's read and pixel support (:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`): logistic regression on the features and their squares, an isotonic recalibration of that score, histogram gradient boosting, and the decoy rate of matched strata. A real call's error is then ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``, and ``genotype_confidence`` is one minus it. A control fits the logistic model on decoy labels shuffled within fields; its AUC should be 0.5.
records.translation: 디코이에 대한 호출은 알려진 거짓 호출입니다. 시퀀싱 시야별 아웃 오브 폴드 방식으로(시야 이름을 키로 한 5개 폴드이므로, 어떤 시야도 그것을 본 모델로 채점되지 않음), 네 모델이 각 호출의 리드 및 픽셀 근거(:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`)에서 P(decoy | evidence)를 추정합니다. 특징과 그 제곱에 대한 로지스틱 회귀, 그 점수의 isotonic 재보정, 히스토그램 그래디언트 부스팅, 일치시킨 층의 디코이 비율입니다. 그러면 실제 호출의 오류는 ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``이며, ``genotype_confidence``는 1에서 그 값을 뺀 것입니다. 대조군은 시야 안에서 섞은 디코이 레이블로 로지스틱 모델을 적합하며, 그 AUC는 0.5여야 합니다.

records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the laboratory microplate's maps once, before the microplate sample positions, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's microscope field of view-edge flags and flat-microscope field of view gains from the saved masks. A processing session of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``merge``) writes each microscope field of view to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw extracted image regions of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping microscope fields of view (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each microplate sample position's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its microscope fields of view are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the microplate sample positions decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also executes after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other workflows' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also executes after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).

records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the plate's maps once, before the wells, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's field-edge flags and flat-field gains from the saved masks. A run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per well, after ``merge``) writes each field to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw crops of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per well, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping fields (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each well's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its fields are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the wells decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also runs after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other pipelines' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also runs after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).
records.translation: ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"``, ``"decode"`` 중 원하는 것으로, 이 순서대로 실행됩니다. 빠진 단계는 필요한 것을 데이터베이스에서 읽으므로, 웰을 한 번 스티칭한 뒤 다시 디코딩할 수 있습니다. 알파 표현형 경로는 ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"``, ``"aggregate"``를 추가하며, 여기에 이름을 적었을 때만 앞의 네 단계 뒤에 실행됩니다. ``ph_flatfield``는 웰보다 먼저 플레이트의 맵을 한 번 만들고, ``ph_masks``는 저장된 마스크에서 각 세포의 시야 가장자리 플래그와 플랫필드 이득을 기록합니다. 이 단계만 실행할 때는 ``dst_root``와 ``plate``가 필요하지만 ``genotype_source``는 필요 없으며, 웰은 ``ops_phenotype``에서 가져오고, 각 웰의 ``ops_report.json``을 교체하지 않고 내용을 추가합니다. ``aggregate``는 실행한 웰을 합쳐 ``ops_guides_<plate>``와 ``ops_genes_<plate>``를 기록합니다. ``"ph_merged"``(웰마다, ``merge`` 뒤)는 각 시야를 ``merged/``에 기록하고(:func:`_ph_merged`), ``"ph_tables"``(``aggregate`` 뒤)는 표준 ``measurements/measurements.db`` 테이블을 기록하며(:func:`_ph_tables`), ``"ph_crops"``는 소유된 세포의 원시 크롭을 샤드 저장소에 잘라 넣습니다(:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"``(웰마다, ``ph_masks`` 뒤)은 겹치는 시야에 걸친 각 세포의 사본을 찾습니다(:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). 마지막의 ``"report"``는 수율 깔때기와 공개 테이블 대비 개수를 ``results/ops_report/``에 기록합니다(:func:`_ph_report`). ``ops_ph_secondary_registration``을 설정하면 각 웰의 두 번째 표현형 획득을 시야를 읽기 전에 정합합니다(:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). 알파 ``decode_qc`` 단계(항목 876, 877)는 디코딩한 웰에 대해 거짓 호출 모델과 유전자형 신뢰도를 적합하여 ``results/ops_decode_qc``를 기록하며, ``decode`` 뒤에도 실행되는데 이는 ``ops_decode_qc`` 또는 ``ops_genotype_confidence``가 켜져 있을 때입니다. 알파 ``compare_calls`` 단계(항목 878)는 spaCR의 호출을 다른 파이프라인의 세포별 테이블(``ops_compare_tables``)과 일치시키고 ``results/ops_compare``를 기록하며, 그 테이블을 설정하면 ``decode`` 뒤에도 실행됩니다. 알파 프로파일 경로인 ``"profile"``과 ``"evaluate"``는 단독으로 실행됩니다. ``ops_profile_cells``의 저장된 세포 테이블을 유전자 프로파일로 바꾸고 기준 유전자 쌍과 비교해 채점합니다(:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).

records.context: Base-shuffled decoy barcodes, ``k`` per guide, for a decoy FDR.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.decoy_library#0
records.source: Base-shuffled decoy barcodes, ``k`` per guide, for a decoy FDR.
records.translation: 디코이 FDR을 위한 염기 셔플 디코이 바코드로, 가이드당 ``k``개입니다.

records.context: Each decoy is a permutation of one guide's letters, so it keeps that guide's base composition, and it is accepted only when it lies at least two edits from every guide and every decoy taken before it -- the same separation the library was designed with. Matched alongside the real library, a decoy call is a call that cannot be true, and ``k`` decoys per guide measure a rare false match ``k`` times as precisely.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.decoy_library#1
records.source: Each decoy is a permutation of one guide's letters, so it keeps that guide's base composition, and it is accepted only when it lies at least two edits from every guide and every decoy taken before it -- the same separation the library was designed with. Matched alongside the real library, a decoy call is a call that cannot be true, and ``k`` decoys per guide measure a rare false match ``k`` times as precisely.
records.translation: 각 디코이는 가이드 하나의 문자를 순열한 것이므로 그 가이드의 염기 조성을 유지하며, 모든 가이드와 그 앞에 뽑은 모든 디코이로부터 적어도 편집 두 번 떨어져 있을 때만 받아들입니다 -- 라이브러리를 설계할 때의 분리도와 같습니다. 실제 라이브러리와 함께 일치시키면 디코이 호출은 참일 수 없는 호출이며, 가이드당 ``k``개의 디코이는 드문 거짓 일치를 ``k``배 정밀하게 측정합니다.

records.context: Call bases with per-cycle axes learnt from the reads the library names.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.library_calibrated_bases#0
records.source: Call bases with per-cycle axes learnt from the reads the library names.
records.translation: 라이브러리가 식별하는 리드에서 학습한 주기별 축으로 염기를 호출합니다.

records.context: The reads are first normalised per cycle and unmixed with brieflow's median transform. Then, for each read and cycle, the read is matched on its OTHER cycles; when exactly one guide fits, that guide names the true base at the masked cycle without looking at it. Per cycle, the median intensity of the reads labelled with each base is that base's axis; the four axes, scaled to sum to one, are inverted and every read of the cycle is unmixed with them. Labels come from the real library only, so a decoy library matched later stays an independent false-match control. This is the "S1b" calibration of the decode-yield study (item 873).
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.library_calibrated_bases#1
records.source: The reads are first normalised per cycle and unmixed with brieflow's median transform. Then, for each read and cycle, the read is matched on its OTHER cycles; when exactly one guide fits, that guide names the true base at the masked cycle without looking at it. Per cycle, the median intensity of the reads labelled with each base is that base's axis; the four axes, scaled to sum to one, are inverted and every read of the cycle is unmixed with them. Labels come from the real library only, so a decoy library matched later stays an independent false-match control. This is the "S1b" calibration of the decode-yield study (item 873).
records.translation: 리드는 먼저 주기마다 정규화하고 brieflow의 median 변환으로 언믹싱합니다. 그런 다음 각 리드와 주기에 대해, 리드를 다른 주기에서 일치시킵니다. 정확히 하나의 가이드가 맞으면, 그 가이드는 가려진 주기를 보지 않고도 그 주기의 실제 염기를 알려 줍니다. 주기마다 각 염기로 레이블이 붙은 리드의 중앙 강도가 그 염기의 축이며, 합이 1이 되도록 스케일링한 네 축의 역행렬로 그 주기의 모든 리드를 언믹싱합니다. 레이블은 실제 라이브러리에서만 얻으므로, 나중에 일치시키는 디코이 라이브러리는 독립적인 거짓 일치 대조로 남습니다. 이는 디코딩 수율 연구(항목 873)의 "S1b" 보정입니다.

records.context: The cells of every microplate sample position are filtered and imputed (:func:`_profile_well`), embedded by a PCA keeping 99 % of the variance (:func:`_profile_embedding`), normalised by TVN on the control cells with the microplate sample position as batch (:func:`tvn_on_controls`, whitening epsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0 is Brieflow's TVN and is computed at single precision as Brieflow does, a positive value at double), and reduced to guides (median of cells) and genes (median of guides, or of cells), keeping rows with more than ``ops_profile_min_cells`` cells. records.label: spacr.ops_tvn.profile_cell_tables#1
records.source: The cells of every well are filtered and imputed (:func:`_profile_well`), embedded by a PCA keeping 99 % of the variance (:func:`_profile_embedding`), normalised by TVN on the control cells with the well as batch (:func:`tvn_on_controls`, whitening epsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0 is Brieflow's TVN and is computed at single precision as Brieflow does, a positive value at double), and reduced to guides (median of cells) and genes (median of guides, or of cells), keeping rows with more than ``ops_profile_min_cells`` cells. A hits table can then keep only active genes and the control rows.
records.translation: 모든 웰의 세포를 필터링하고 대체하며(:func:`_profile_well`), 분산의 99 %를 유지하는 PCA로 임베딩하고(:func:`_profile_embedding`), 웰을 배치로 하여 대조군 세포 기반 TVN으로 정규화하고(:func:`tvn_on_controls`, 백색화 epsilon ``ops_tvn_whiten_epsilon``; 0은 Brieflow의 TVN이며 Brieflow처럼 single 정밀도로 계산하고, 양수 값은 double로 계산), 가이드(세포의 중앙값)와 유전자(가이드 또는 세포의 중앙값)로 요약하며, 세포가 ``ops_profile_min_cells``보다 많은 행을 유지합니다. 그런 다음 히트 테이블로 활성 유전자와 대조군 행만 남길 수 있습니다.

records.context: For every reported panel of a figure (``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` or ``relative_plaque_size``), each labelling of the microplate sample positions gives the measured value of a condition as the mean over its matching microplate sample positions (:func:`condition_matches`); the measured effect is that over the reference condition's, and the reported effect is the panel's value over its reference value. The summary has, per labelling and readout (area, number, all), Spearman's rho of the log2 effects (clipped at 0.02), how many effects that differ from 1 by more than 15% point the same way, how many agree within 1.5-fold, and a permutation control: rho with the measured effects shuffled ``compare_permutations`` times (seed ``compare_seed``), its mean, its 95th percentile and a one-sided p.
records.label: spacr.plaque_papers.compare_reported#1
records.source: For every reported panel of a figure (``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` or ``relative_plaque_size``), each labelling of the wells gives the measured value of a condition as the mean over its matching wells (:func:`condition_matches`); the measured effect is that over the reference condition's, and the reported effect is the panel's value over its reference value. The summary has, per labelling and readout (area, number, all), Spearman's rho of the log2 effects (clipped at 0.02), how many effects that differ from 1 by more than 15% point the same way, how many agree within 1.5-fold, and a permutation control: rho with the measured effects shuffled ``compare_permutations`` times (seed ``compare_seed``), its mean, its 95th percentile and a one-sided p.
records.translation: 그림의 보고된 패널(``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` 또는 ``relative_plaque_size``)마다, 웰의 각 레이블링은 조건의 측정값을 일치하는 웰의 평균으로 제공합니다(:func:`condition_matches`). 측정 효과는 그 값을 기준 조건의 값으로 나눈 것이고, 보고 효과는 패널 값을 그 기준값으로 나눈 것입니다. 요약에는 레이블링과 판독(area, number, all)마다 log2 효과의 Spearman's rho(0.02에서 잘라 냄), 1과 15%보다 크게 다른 효과 중 같은 방향인 수, 1.5배 이내로 일치하는 수, 그리고 순열 대조가 있습니다. 순열 대조는 측정 효과를 ``compare_permutations``번 섞었을 때(시드 ``compare_seed``)의 rho, 그 평균, 95번째 백분위수, 단측 p입니다.

Every record is kept; flags mark what is not measured (``rejected_not_plaque``, ``zoom_duplicate``) and what needs a second look (``low_confidence`` at or under ``figure_low_confidence``, ``snap_*``, ``reader_second_look`` for the tasks in ``figure_second_look``). records.source: Wells are the detector boxes the full reading (``vlm_index_all/annotations.json``) called plaque images plus the missed tiles the check round kept (``vlm_index_all/check_snapped/annotations_new.json``). Every record is kept; flags mark what is not measured (``rejected_not_plaque``, ``zoom_duplicate``) and what needs a second look (``low_confidence`` at or under ``figure_low_confidence``, ``snap_*``, ``reader_second_look`` for the tasks in ``figure_second_look``). Toxoplasma wells go to the main table. Reported values become within-panel effects: value over the panel's reference value, and log2 of it (floored at 1/1000 of the reference).
records.translation: 웰은 전체 판독(``vlm_index_all/annotations.json``)이 플라크 이미지라고 판정한 검출기 상자와, 확인 라운드가 유지한 누락 타일(``vlm_index_all/check_snapped/annotations_new.json``)입니다. 모든 기록을 유지하며, 플래그는 측정하지 않는 것(``rejected_not_plaque``, ``zoom_duplicate``)과 재검토가 필요한 것(``low_confidence``는 ``figure_low_confidence`` 이하, ``snap_*``, ``reader_second_look``는 ``figure_second_look``의 작업)을 표시합니다. Toxoplasma 웰은 주 테이블로 갑니다. 보고값은 패널 내 효과가 됩니다. 값을 패널의 기준값으로 나눈 것과 그 log2(기준의 1/1000을 하한으로 함)입니다.

records.context: Statistics, on the upper triangle of the two gene x gene similarity matrices: the Mantel statistic (Spearman, i.e. Pearson of tie-averaged ranks; Mantel 1967); the partial Mantel statistic after both rank vectors are residualised on the rank similarity of screening experiment A's fitness and of screening experiment B's profile strength; the overlap of the ``k`` nearest neighbours; and, of the pairs in the top ``top_fraction`` of both screening experiments, their number and the share that are known (STRING >= 0.7). Each is recomputed for ``n_perm`` relabellings of screening experiment A's genes: unrestricted, then within fitness deciles, within STRING-degree deciles and within strength deciles, all drawn from one ``default_rng(seed)`` in that order. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.cross_screen_concordance#1
records.source: Statistics, on the upper triangle of the two gene x gene similarity matrices: the Mantel statistic (Spearman, i.e. Pearson of tie-averaged ranks; Mantel 1967); the partial Mantel statistic after both rank vectors are residualised on the rank similarity of screen A's fitness and of screen B's profile strength; the overlap of the ``k`` nearest neighbours; and, of the pairs in the top ``top_fraction`` of both screens, their number and the share that are known (STRING >= 0.7). Each is recomputed for ``n_perm`` relabellings of screen A's genes: unrestricted, then within fitness deciles, within STRING-degree deciles and within strength deciles, all drawn from one ``default_rng(seed)`` in that order. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``.
records.translation: 두 유전자 x 유전자 유사도 행렬의 위쪽 삼각형에서 구하는 통계량입니다. Mantel 통계량(Spearman, 즉 동률 평균 순위의 Pearson; Mantel 1967), 두 순위 벡터를 스크린 A의 적합도와 스크린 B의 프로파일 강도의 순위 유사도에 대해 잔차화한 뒤의 부분 Mantel 통계량, ``k``개 최근접 이웃의 중첩, 그리고 두 스크린 모두의 상위 ``top_fraction`` 쌍의 수와 그중 알려진 쌍의 비율(STRING >= 0.7)입니다. 각각을 스크린 A 유전자의 ``n_perm``번 레이블 재배정에 대해 다시 계산합니다. 제한 없음, 적합도 십분위 내, STRING 차수 십분위 내, 강도 십분위 내 순서이며, 모두 하나의 ``default_rng(seed)``에서 그 순서로 추출합니다. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``입니다.

records.context: The procedure of the jump cpjump1 benchmark (Chandrasekaran et al. 2024). Per modality the microplate sample positions are normalised per laboratory microplate against the negative controls and feature-selected; replicate retrieval is scored on the real labels and on labels shuffled within laboratory microplates, and the laboratory microplate effect on the real and on permuted laboratory microplate labels, all from one ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)`` in that order; the laboratory microplate effect is then scored before normalisation. Compound consensus profiles are matched to the CRISPR and ORF gene consensus profiles on the features every modality kept, for all treatments and for replicable ones only, by cosine and absolute cosine, each with a shuffled-annotation control (``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``).
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.profile_retrieval#1
records.source: The procedure of the JUMP CPJUMP1 benchmark (Chandrasekaran et al. 2024). Per modality the wells are normalised per plate against the negative controls and feature-selected; replicate retrieval is scored on the real labels and on labels shuffled within plates, and the plate effect on the real and on permuted plate labels, all from one ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)`` in that order; the plate effect is then scored before normalisation. Compound consensus profiles are matched to the CRISPR and ORF gene consensus profiles on the features every modality kept, for all treatments and for replicable ones only, by cosine and absolute cosine, each with a shuffled-annotation control (``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``).
records.translation: JUMP CPJUMP1 벤치마크(Chandrasekaran et al. 2024)의 절차입니다. 모달리티마다 웰을 플레이트별로 음성 대조군에 대해 정규화하고 특징을 선택합니다. 반복 retrieval은 실제 레이블과 플레이트 안에서 섞은 레이블로 채점하고, 플레이트 효과는 실제 플레이트 레이블과 순열한 플레이트 레이블로 채점하며, 모두 하나의 ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)``에서 그 순서로 추출합니다. 이어서 플레이트 효과를 정규화 전에 채점합니다. 화합물 합의 프로파일은 모든 모달리티가 유지한 특징에서 CRISPR 및 ORF 유전자 합의 프로파일과 일치시키며, 모든 처리와 반복 가능한 처리만에 대해, cosine과 절대 cosine으로, 각각 셔플 주석 대조(``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``)와 함께 수행합니다.
